hits.about: Gianfranco Ferre Residences, an innovative project created by MIRA Developments in collaboration with the famous Italian house Gianfranco Ferré, is located on the first shoreline of the picturesque Al Marjan Island. The laconic shape of the Latin letter "U", the absence of sharp corners and the continuous fluidity of the facade of the building attract the eye, symbolizing the endless enjoyment of life in Gianfranco Ferre Residences.Luxury studios and one and two-bedroom apartments are available for purchase. The charm of oriental fairy tales is embodied here with the use of advanced western technology. The timeless elegance of Italian style can be read in the interiors of the complex. Each of the apartments has panoramic windows, from which opens a magnificent view of the coast. The restrained sophistication of the combination of white and beige shades in the interior decoration of private and common spaces harmonizes with the rich fabrics of upholstery furniture made of expensive woods, including walnut Canaletto.The creators of the complex have taken care of the safety and comfort of the residents of Gianfranco Ferre Residences. A video surveillance system, concierge service, guarded parking lot will save you from unnecessary worries. A landscaped recreation area, children's playground, swimming pool, equipped gymnasium, kworking area will provide residents with maximum comfort for life.Al Marjan Island's close proximity to shopping and business centers as well as major airports makes Gianfranco Ferre Residences an easily accessible place. RAK Mall can be reached in 10 minutes. Ras Al Khaimah Airport is a 30-minute drive away, while Dubai airport is a 45-minute drive away.
